pattern: Native <fieldset> + <legend> grouping native checkboxes, each with a <label for> (HTML; WAI-ARIA APG Checkbox).

aria.value: Group help text and visible error message ids
That option's help text id, when present
"true" on every checkbox while the group error is shown (the group role does not support aria-invalid)

keyboard.action: Moves focus through each enabled checkbox in order.

focus: Each native input is a tab stop and shows a color-focus-ring outline on :focus-visible.
notes: The required asterisk is aria-hidden. Because checkboxes and the group role cannot carry aria-required, a visually hidden "(required)" (localizable message checkboxGroup.required) is part of the legend.
Checked state is shown by a check mark, not only by the fill color.
Errors appear after focus leaves the group by default, not when moving between options.
knownCaveats: Announcement of fieldset aria-describedby varies by screen reader; not yet manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
